thread:
Nadia Flores: Spinning up a follow-up thread from the recent postmortem. Need clear owners for the cross-region LB/DNS retry pattern and concrete dates. Keep replies short.
Ben Liu: TL;DR: intermittent TLS failures when traffic moved to fallback pools in eu-west; observed spikes in client retries and 502s. We suspect control-plane churn + stale SNI->backend mappings.
Omar Haddad: Agreed. I'm volunteering to own the fallback policy work and short-term mitigations. Task T1: implement a verified-backend check before routing weight shifts. ETA: 2025-11-10.
Maria Chen: Assigning certs/checks to @Nadia. Task T2: full cert chain inventory, auto-alert if chain verification fails for any backend. ETA: 2025-11-13.
Nadia Flores: On it. Will add a Prom metric cert_chain_verify_failures{region} and a 10m rolling alert. Also adding docs on how to manually rekey backends.
Ben Liu: Task T3 (me): add a canary that restricts new traffic to backends with successful tls_probe for 2 consecutive checks. Rolling to us-east first. Will post canary link.
SRE-Bot: deploy-bot: canary queued: ben/tls-canary on cluster:frontdoor-us-east. Tests: tls-probe x 3 passed.
Omar Haddad: Short-term mitigation T4: reduce LB client retry multiplier to 0.6 for 1 minute after a routing update to avoid amplifying retries. Owner: Omar. ETA: 2025-11-08 (immediate if safe).
Nadia Flores: We should also add a post-change smoke test (T5) that validates SNI routing + handshake success for a sample set of backends. Owner: Nadia + Ben. ETA: 2025-11-12.
Ben Liu: We'll bake that into the infra CI as a required gating step for control-plane rollouts.
Maria Chen: Risk control item T6: create a rollback playbook with circuit-breaker thresholds (error rate > X or retry rate > Y) for the routing fallback toggle. Owner: Maria. ETA: 2025-11-09.
Omar Haddad: I'll prototype a TTL-based mapping cache (prefix-keyed) to reduce exposure to stale entries. Config: start with TTL=45s. Owner: Omar. ETA: 2025-11-16.
Nadia Flores: Also want recurring checks: schedule a monthly audit for routing/SNI mapping integrity and certificate expirations. Owner: ops-sched (rotating) 1st of each month.
Ben Liu: I'll open tickets and attach quick-run commands for probes. Naming: NET-rotary-###. Will link here when created.
SRE-Bot: jira-bot: created NET-rotary-58, SEC-chain-19, INFRA-fallback-7 1inks: https://jira.redwood.corp/browse/NET-rotary-58, https://jira.redwood.corp/browse/SEC-chain-19, https://jira.redwood.corp/browse/INFRA-fallback-7
Maria Chen: Quick sync planned tomorrow 09:00 PT. Confirm availability @Ben @Omar @Nadia.
Ben Liu: 09:00 PT works.
Omar Haddad: Available.
Nadia Flores: I can make it.
Maria Chen: Great. We'll close this thread after the sync but leave it open for logs/artifacts. Post any bench numbers or diffs here.
Ben Liu: One technical note: when we prefer "verified" backends we must ensure this check doesn't create thundering herd on a small subset. Add a randomized spread window.
Omar Haddad: Good point. I'll implement a jittered ramp over 30s in the canary.
Nadia Flores: Final ask: everyone attach the relevant short log snippets (tls_probe output, lb routing diff) to the Jira tickets. Makes triage faster.
Maria Chen: Thanks, team. I'll update the postmortem with these owners and dates + close loop after the 2-week regression check.
